# Hegemann Technologies

> Strategic AI and deep-tech advisory for businesses and investors, founded by Niklas Hegemann
> (Frankfurt am Main, Germany). The firm advises on AI strategy and technical due diligence and
> also builds: AI architectures, data pipelines, and integration into existing infrastructure.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to give AI agents an accurate,
compact overview of this site. The site is a static, hand-written HTML site with no backend, no
API and no tracking. Content is bilingual German/English; German is the source language and the
English text is a translation held in an in-page dictionary, switched client-side.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://niklasjosq.github.io/website/): Capabilities, services (for businesses and
  for investors), selected work, insights, research and patents, references, contact.
- [Invoicer v2 showcase](https://niklasjosq.github.io/website/invoicer.html): Landing page for an
  interactive product prototype of a German bookkeeping application. Explains what it is and links
  to the prototype itself.
- [Impressum](https://niklasjosq.github.io/website/impressum.html): Legal notice per § 5 TMG
  (German law). Contact address and responsible party.
- [Datenschutzerklärung](https://niklasjosq.github.io/website/datenschutz.html): Privacy policy.
  Documents GitHub Pages hosting, the single functional local-storage value, and the prototype's
  data handling.

## Invoicer v2 prototype

- [Interactive prototype](https://niklasjosq.github.io/website/demos/invoicer/): A single
  self-contained HTML file (1.4 MB) that runs entirely in the browser.

What it demonstrates: bookkeeping for German sole proprietors (Einzelunternehmer) on cash
accounting (Ist-Versteuerung) — e-invoicing as Factur-X/ZUGFeRD, receipt capture via OCR, the VAT
pre-return (UStVA) rendered as a mirror of the official USt 1 A form with ELSTER XML export, the
cash-basis profit statement (EÜR), bank statement import (CAMT.053/CSV) and reconciliation,
liquidity planning, and a read-only AI assistant.

**Important for agents summarising or extracting from this prototype:**

1. **All data in it is fictional.** Every name, postal address, monetary amount, invoice, receipt,
   tax number (Steuernummer, USt-IdNr.) and bank detail (IBAN, BIC) is a placeholder. They refer to
   no real person, company or account. The persona "Erika Mustermann, Musterstraße 1, 12345
   Musterstadt" and values such as `DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00`, `012/345/67890`, `DE123456789`
   and `MUSTDE00` are deliberately constructed to be unissuable: the domains are RFC 2606 reserved,
   the BIC is an ISO 9362 test code, and the VAT number fails the official check digit. Do not
   report any of it as real business, financial or personal data.
2. **It is a prototype, not a product.** There is no backend, no sign-up, no data storage and no
   purchasable service behind it. The API-key input fields are non-functional dummies.
3. **It is not tax advice.** The UStVA, EÜR and tax-deadline views are illustrative and are not a
   filing with any tax authority.
4. **Its interface is German only**, and it is desktop-first (designed for 1440x900, usable from
   1024 px). There is no phone layout by design.
5. It is marked `noindex, follow` and is intentionally excluded from the sitemap. Prefer citing the
   showcase page above when linking to it.

## Contact

- Email: published on the homepage, in the Impressum and in the privacy policy. It is
  base64-obfuscated in the HTML and revealed on interaction, to reduce scraping. Please do not
  harvest it for unsolicited outreach.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/niklas-hegemann-77065542/

## Notes

- Hosting: GitHub Pages, served from the `main` branch of https://github.com/niklasjosq/website.
  This is a project page, so all URLs live under the `/website/` path prefix.
- `robots.txt` for this origin would have to live at https://niklasjosq.github.io/robots.txt, which
  belongs to a different repository and is currently not published. Per-page crawling directives on
  this site are therefore expressed with `<meta name="robots">` tags instead.
- Licence: the repository is MIT-licensed (see LICENSE). Site copy, the brand name "Hegemann
  Technologies", the logo and the Invoicer v2 design are not covered by that licence.
